main_body: stone pedestal basin filled with water
top_band: elliptical rim and water surface from row 2 to row 6 (back rim row 2, water rows 3-5, front rim row 6)
evidence: Reading down a central column: row 2 is the bright white stone back rim; rows 3-5 show the elliptical water basin interior (dark blue inner wall shadow at row 3, lighter blue water with highlight at rows 4-5); row 6 is the light grey front rim edge; rows 7-14 form the shaded underside of the bowl, stem, and stepped base.

style.evidence: The stone font uses a 6-step cool grey ramp from near-white highlight to deep slate shadow, plus a 4-step blue ramp for the water with specular reflection. Outlines are dark cool grey rather than pure black, and every 16x16 section has crisp volumetric shading comparable to the well reference.
